title: Seraph foundation model
description: Front-matter contracts for the active foundation. Markdown bodies hold authored prose.

RecordBase.title: Shared record fields
RecordBase.description: Shared record metadata. Creation means record creation, not the creation of the subject described.

created_at.description: Shared field. Timestamp when this record was created in the workspace, with a timezone. Null when unknown; never inferred from names, media dates, filesystem timestamps, or rebuild time.

visibility.description: Public records may be published. Private records are excluded from public catalogs and routes.

Horizon.title: Horizon
Horizon.description: A value, guiding principle, long-term vision, or near-term goal for the practice. Levels progress from foundational purpose toward concrete action. Level measures the role of a horizon, not its importance or how far in the future it lies.

visibility.description: Existing Horizons with no visibility field are public. The creation helper writes private explicitly.

level.description: 1 — Values: enduring goods that give the practice its purpose. 2 — Guiding principles: ongoing commitments that shape decisions and how the values are practiced. 3 — Long-term vision: the future way of life, community, or organization the practice seeks to bring about. 4 — Near-term goals: concrete outcomes or milestones pursued to advance the vision. Classify by role, not deadline: a long-term vision remains level 3 even when it becomes closer in time.

description.description: The value or guiding perspective expressed in full.

OrganicMemory.title: Organic Memory
OrganicMemory.description: An authored recollection of a lived experience that can be revisited. The recollection lives in the Markdown body.

Mix.title: Mix
Mix.description: One dated version of a song with an object key for its audio file in private storage.

date.description: Version date in YYYY-MM-DD. The song identifier and version date together identify the mix.

audio_file.description: Stable object key within the configured private audio bucket, for example mixes/coldness/2026-04-04.wav. Use slash-separated segments of ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots. Start each segment with a letter, digit, underscore or hyphen.
